quarterly_data.quarter: Tokyo Electron semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025) results: net sales JPY 1,179,668 million (+5.2% YoY), operating income JPY 303,153 million (-3.4%), net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 241,626 million (-0.9%). R&D expense JPY 134,827 million (+16.7%); purchases of property, plant and equipment JPY 135,392 million. Management states that AI-server demand for data centers drove the semiconductor market, and that in the equipment market capex for mature nodes in China paused compared with a year earlier while capex for generative-AI memory and advanced packaging grew markedly.
